scope: Normal encounter: selected released methods and source-derived branching, no live combat certification.
side_head_target_finding: Both selected left/right fireball activation lambdas read THIRD_ATTACK_TARGET. Left activation start condition in pinned source checks SECOND_ATTACK_TARGET; this mismatch needs multiplayer runtime acceptance.
reload_finding: Released readAdditionalSaveData sets doneFireBomb true when restored health/max health <=0.5; it reconstructs state from health rather than proving the phase actually ran.
limits: Energy is determined by the active damage-type tag, not weapon appearance or every magic source
Melee classification is checked before energy; overlapping classifications follow the melee branch
Half health alone does not guarantee immediate Fire Bomb: done flag, aura, live target and scheduler conditions also apply
Do not treat additional-head source mismatch as a reproduced multiplayer bug
